topic_ko: 유럽 복식 변천과 사회 계층의 연관성
_note: 어법(논설문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab 의 밑줄 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재. blank/insert 의 target·text 는 해당 유형 passage 에 글자 그대로 존재.

passage: Fashion has always been deeply rooted in culture, and a fine illustration of this can be found in the history of European dress.
During the early Middle Ages, garments were generally simple and were frequently made of rough wool or animal skins.
As cloth-making techniques improved, however, fashion moved toward styles that were increasingly elaborate and body-hugging.
By the Renaissance and Elizabethan periods, clothing had become even more refined and carefully constructed.
The garments worn by the wealthy grew increasingly fancier, drawing particular attention to the waistline.
The tie between clothing and social rank was so clear that laws were passed for to restrict the use of certain luxury goods.
These decorative items — feathers, silk, velvet — were exclusive to the upper classes and served as markers of status.
Such distinctions became deeply embedded in ceremonial dress, so that the rank of each participant could be identified at a glance.
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 'for to restrict'는 어법상 틀리다. to부정사 앞에 for를 덧붙일 수 없다(for + 명사 = 의미상 주어 구문이지만, 단순 목적의 to부정사 앞에 for는 불필요하고 비문법적). 'to restrict'로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①can be found(수동태 올바름), ②that were increasingly elaborate(관계사절 주격 관계대명사 that 올바름), ③drawing particular attention(현재분사 분사구문 올바름), ⑤could be identified(수동 조동사 구문 올바름).

passage: Fashion is always deeply connected to culture, and European clothing history provides an excellent illustration of this.
In the early Middle Ages, clothing was plain and was commonly crafted from rough wool or animal furs.
With improvements in textile production, however, fashion evolved toward more intricate and body-conscious styles.
During the Renaissance and Elizabethan periods, clothing became even more sophisticated.
Wealthy individuals wore increasingly elaborate garments, with special emphasis placed on a narrower waistline.
The link between dress and social rank was so obscure that laws were established to control access to certain luxury items.
Upper-class decorations — including feathers, silk, and velvet — served as displays of social position.
This pattern was further strengthened as elite attire was formally woven into ceremonial events to signal status.
vocab.explanation_ko: ③ 'obscure(불분명한, 모호한)'는 문맥상 어색하다. 복식과 사회적 지위의 연관성이 너무 뚜렷했기 때문에 법률이 제정되었다는 내용이므로, '뚜렷한'을 의미하는 'pronounced'로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①intricate(정교한), ②sophisticated(세련된), ④displays(전시, 과시), ⑤strengthened(강화되었다)는 모두 문맥상 적절하다.

passage: Fashion has always been a product of culture, and the history of European clothing makes this abundantly clear.
In the early Middle Ages, garments were simple and were often made from coarse wool or animal furs.
As textile technology advanced, clothing began moving toward more elaborate and fitted styles.
In the Renaissance and Elizabethan eras, fashion became even more refined and expressive of wealth.
Wealthy people wore increasingly ornate clothing, with special focus on a slimmer waist.
The bond between clothing and social rank grew so strong that governments passed laws to restrict luxury items to the privileged.
Feathers, silk, and velvet — reserved for the higher classes — became unmistakable signals of social rank.
This link between dress and hierarchy was ultimately __________ when upper-class styles were formally embedded in cultural ceremonies, making each wearer's role visible at a glance.
choices: obscured by the growing complexity of fashion
cemented as ceremonial dress made status publicly visible
weakened as more people gained access to luxury goods
reversed when the lower classes adopted elite styles
blank.explanation_ko: 앞에서 복식이 사회 계층을 드러내는 수단으로 자리잡았음을 설명하고, 빈칸 뒤에 상류층 스타일이 의식에 편입되어 착용자의 역할이 가시화되었다는 내용이 이어진다. 따라서 이 연관성이 '의식 복식이 지위를 공개적으로 드러내면서 굳어졌다'는 ③이 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ①사회 이동성 도전, ②패션 복잡성으로 모호해짐, ④사치품 접근 확대, ⑤하류층이 상류층 스타일 채택은 모두 본문 흐름과 반대이다.

order.given: Fashion is always deeply cultural, and an excellent example of this can be seen in the evolution of European clothing. At the beginning of the Middle Ages, clothing tended to be simple and was frequently made of rough wool or animal furs.

blocks.A: The connection between clothing and social status was so pronounced that laws were enacted to limit the wearing of certain luxury items. Allowed only for higher social classes, luxurious styles such as feathers, silk, or velvet demonstrated one's standing in society.
blocks.B: With advances in cloth making, however, fashion began moving toward styles that were more elaborate and form-fitting. In the Renaissance and Elizabethan eras, styles became even more refined, with particular emphasis on smaller waists.
blocks.C: This distinction was further reinforced as upper-class styles came to be incorporated into cultural ceremonies, so that each wearer's social role could be clearly identified.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(중세 단순 복식) 다음에 (B)에서 기술 발전으로 정교해진 스타일을 설명하고, (A)에서 사회 계층과 연관된 사치 금지법이 등장하며, (C)에서 의식에 통합되어 계층 식별이 제도화되는 결론으로 이어진다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 직물 기술 발전이 중세 초기 바로 다음에 와야 하고, (A)의 법률 제정은 정교한 복식이 확립된 이후의 결과이며, (C)의 의식 통합은 최종 제도화 단계이다.

insert.insert_sentence: Allowed only for higher social classes, luxurious styles and decorations such as feathers, silk, or velvet were used as a means of demonstrating one's standing in society.

passage_marked.text: Fashion is always deeply cultural, and an excellent example of this can be seen in the evolution of European clothing.
At the beginning of the Middle Ages, clothing tended to be simple and was frequently made of rough wool or animal furs.
With advances in cloth making, however, fashion began moving toward styles that were more elaborate and form-fitting.
The connection between clothing and social status was so pronounced that laws were enacted to limit the wearing of certain luxury items.
This was further reinforced as upperclass styles came to be explicitly incorporated into cultural ceremonies so that their wearers' roles could be identified clearly.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장(상류층 전용 사치 스타일이 지위 과시 수단)은 ④ 앞 문장(사치품 착용을 제한하는 법 제정)의 직접적 결과를 설명한다. 또한 ④ 뒤 문장(더욱 강화됨)이 이 계층 구분의 지속을 보여준다. 따라서 ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장은 법 제정(④앞)의 결과이므로 ③(법이 없는 시점) 이전에 오면 흐름이 어색하다. ⑤ 뒤는 글의 결론부여서 새 사례 삽입이 부자연스럽다.

passage: Fashion has always reflected the culture of its time, and European clothing history is a prime example.
In the early Middle Ages, clothing was plain, typically made from wool or animal furs.
As cloth-making advanced, styles grew more elaborate and form-fitting.
In the Renaissance and Elizabethan eras, wealthy people's clothing became increasingly refined.
The connection between dress and social rank was so strong that laws restricted luxury items to the upper classes.
Feathers, silk, and velvet became visible markers of one's place in the social hierarchy.
Upper-class styles were eventually incorporated into ceremonial contexts to make social roles unmistakable.
From simple wool to silk and velvet, clothing became a powerful system for communicating rank.
summary.summary_template: In Europe, fashion evolved from __(A)__ materials in the Middle Ages to increasingly elaborate styles that reflected __(B)__ differences, eventually becoming a formal code of rank embedded in ceremony.
summary.explanation_ko: 유럽 복식이 중세의 (A)단순한(simple) 소재에서 출발해, 사회 계층에 따른 (B)사회적(social) 차이를 반영하는 정교한 스타일로 발전했다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 costly/imported/natural이 아니라 simple이고, (B)는 religious/regional/personal이 아니라 social이어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 의복과 사회적 지위 사이의 연관성은 너무나 뚜렷하여 특정 사치품의 착용을 제한하는 법률이 제정되었다.
writing.answer: The connection between clothing and social status was so pronounced that laws were enacted to limit the wearing of certain luxury items.
writing.explanation_ko: so + 형용사 + that 결과 구문(너무 ~해서 …하다). laws were enacted(법률이 제정되었다) 수동태, to limit = 목적의 to부정사.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 높은 사회 계층에게만 허용된 화려한 스타일과 장식들은 사회에서 자신의 위치를 과시하는 수단으로 사용되었다.
writing.answer: Allowed only for higher social classes, luxurious styles and decorations were used as a means of demonstrating one's standing in society.
writing.explanation_ko: 수동 분사구문 Allowed only for ...로 시작. a means of + 동명사(demonstrating) = '~하는 수단으로'.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그러나 직물 제조의 발전에 따라, 패션은 더 정교하고 몸에 딱 맞는 스타일로 이동하기 시작했다.
conditions: 관계대명사 that을 사용하여 styles를 수식할 것
writing.answer: With advances in cloth making, however, fashion began moving toward styles that were more elaborate and form-fitting.
writing.explanation_ko: With advances in cloth making = 전치사구 조건부. fashion began moving toward styles = 동사구. styles that were more elaborate and form-fitting = 관계사절 수식.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: This was further reinforced as upperclass styles came to be explicitly incorporated into cultural ceremonies so that their wearers' roles could be identified clearly.
writing.answer: 이는 상류층의 스타일이 문화적 의식에 명시적으로 통합되게 됨에 따라 더욱 강화되었으며, 그 결과 착용자들의 역할이 명확하게 식별될 수 있었다.
writing.explanation_ko: be further reinforced(더욱 강화되다), come to be incorporated into(~에 통합되게 되다), so that + 절(~하도록, ~할 수 있도록), could be identified(식별될 수 있었다) 수동태.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: As European fashion became more (A)___________, the link between clothing and (B)___________ status grew so strong that laws were passed to restrict luxury items to the privileged classes.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 직물 기술의 발전으로 스타일이 더 '정교한(elaborate)'이 되었고, (B) 의복과 '사회적(social)' 지위의 연관성이 뚜렷해져 법률이 제정되었다.

writing.context: The connection between clothing and social status was so __________ that laws were enacted to limit the wearing of certain luxury items.
writing.explanation_ko: so + 형용사 + that 결과 구문에서, 의복과 사회적 지위의 연관이 '매우 뚜렷하여' 법률이 제정되었다는 문맥이므로 pronounced(뚜렷한)가 적절하다.
